passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion of our financial condition and results of operations is based upon, and should be read in conjunction with, our audited consolidated financial statements and the related notes included in this annual report on Form 20-F. This report contains forward-looking statements. See “Forward-Looking Information.” In evaluating our business, you should carefully consider the information provided under the caption “Item 3.D. Key Information—Risk Factors” in this annual report on Form 20-F. We caution you that our businesses and financial performance are subject to substantial risks and uncertainties. A. Operating Results Overview We are a leading AI company with a strong internet foundation. We have been consistently investing in AI since 2010 to solidify our technology advancement, improve search capabilities and boost overall monetization. The breadth and depth of our AI capabilities provide the differentiating foundational technologies that power all of our businesses. Revenue Our revenues are derived principally from online marketing services and others. Online marketing services primarily include performance-based online marketing services and other online marketing services. Others primarily include cloud services and video membership services. Costs and Expenses Our costs and expenses consist of cost of revenues, selling, general and administrative expenses, research and development expenses, and impairment of long-lived assets. Share-based compensation expenses are allocated among cost of revenues, selling, general and administrative expenses and research and development expenses, based on the nature of the work of the employees who have received share-based compensation. Cost of Revenue Our cost of revenue primarily consist of content costs, traffic acquisition costs, bandwidth costs, depreciation costs, server custody fees, cost of goods sold and salaries and benefits for operation and service personnel. Selling, General and Administrative Expenses Our selling, general and administrative expenses primarily consist of promotional and marketing expenses, salaries and benefits for our sales, marketing, general and administrative personnel, and expected credit losses. Research and Development Expenses Research and development expenses primarily consist of salaries and benefits for research and development personnel, server depreciation expenses and server custody fees. We expense research and development costs as they are incurred, except for capitalized software development costs that fulfill the capitalization criteria. Impairment of long-lived assets Impairment of long-lived assets consists of impairment losses attributable to the Core asset group. Taxation Cayman Islands Under the current laws of the Cayman Islands, we are not subject to tax on income or capital gains. Additionally, no Cayman Islands withholding tax will be imposed on dividend payments we make. 144 Table of Contents Hong Kong Subsidiaries in Hong Kong are subject to Hong Kong profits tax rate of 16.5% and foreign-derived income is exempted from income tax. There is no withholding tax upon payment of dividends by the subsidiaries incorporated in Hong Ko

passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Summary of Risk Factors An investment in our ADSs or Class A ordinary shares involves significant risks. Below is a summary of material risks we face, organized under relevant headings. All the operational risks associated with being based in and having operations in Chinese mainland also apply to operations in Hong Kong. With respect to the legal risks associated with being based in and having operations in Chinese mainland, the laws, regulations and the discretion of Chinese mainland government authorities discussed in this annual report are expected to apply to Chinese mainland entities and businesses, rather than entities or businesses in Hong Kong which operate under a different set of laws from Chinese mainland. These risks are discussed more fully in “Item 3.D. Key Information—Risk Factors.” Risks Related to Our Business and Industry • If we fail to retain existing customers or attract new customers for our online marketing services, our business, results of operations and growth prospects could be seriously harmed; • Our business and results of operations could continue to be materially and adversely affected by the challenging macroeconomic environment impacting online marketing demand; • Our business depends on a strong brand. If we are unable to maintain and enhance our brand, or if there is negative publicity related to our products and services, our employees, or our business practices, our business and results of operations may be harmed; • We may not be able to achieve the anticipated benefits of our acquisition of YY Live, and face other risks associated with the acquisition and the operation of YY Live; • We face significant competition and may suffer from loss of users and customers as a result; • If our expansions into new businesses are not successful, our results of operation and growth prospects may be materially and adversely affected; • We have made significant investments in foundation models and generative AI and may face uncertainties with respect to their commercialization and the evolving laws and regulations applicable to us; • We have experienced slowdowns and declines in our revenue, and we may sustain net loss from time to time, and we may experience downward pressure on our operating and profit margins in the future; • Potential issues in the adoption and use of artificial intelligence in our product offerings may result in reputational harm or liability; • If we fail to continue to innovate and provide products, services and high-quality internet experience that attract and retain users, we may not be able to remain competitive; we may expend significant resources in order to remain competitive; and • Our business is subject to complex and evolving Chinese and international laws and regulations, including those regarding data privacy and cybersecurity. Failure to comply with these laws and regulations would result in claims, penalties, damages to our reputation and brand, or declines in user growth or engagement, or otherwise harm our business. credit_strengths.text: Baidu's balance sheet remains a core credit strength, with unrestricted cash and short-term investments exceeding reported debt, producing a net cash position. This liquidity cushion provides a substantial buffer against the current earnings downturn and supports the company's ability to meet near-term obligations without external refinancing.

The company retains a large current asset base relative to current liabilities, with a current ratio comfortably above the sector median. This indicates solid short-term liquidity and working capital flexibility, even as operating cash flow turned negative, giving management time to execute its AI investment strategy.

key_risks.text: Baidu's core online marketing business faces persistent pressure from a challenging macroeconomic environment and intense competition, as disclosed in its risk factors. Revenue has declined over the past three fiscal years, and operating income swung to a loss, reflecting structural headwinds that could impair future cash generation and debt servicing capacity.

The company's significant investments in foundation models and generative AI carry commercialization uncertainties and evolving regulatory risks, per the risk factors. These investments, alongside capital expenditures, have contributed to negative free cash flow and operating cash flow, raising concerns about the sustainability of cash returns and the potential need for external funding.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income is insufficient to cover interest expense, with interest coverage negative and well below the sector median. This indicates that current earnings do not support debt servicing, and the company relies on its cash reserves and potential asset sales to meet interest obligations, which is a material credit weakness.

Free cash flow is deeply negative and represents a substantial cash burn relative to debt, while operating cash flow also turned negative. Although the net cash position provides a cushion, the negative free cash flow to debt ratio highlights that the company is not generating sufficient cash to service debt from operations, necessitating balance sheet drawdowns.

overall_credit_view.text: Baidu's credit profile is under pressure from declining revenue, operating losses, and negative free cash flow, driven by macroeconomic headwinds and heavy AI investments. The net cash position and strong liquidity provide a temporary cushion, but the negative interest coverage and cash burn raise concerns about the company's ability to service debt without asset sales or refinancing.

Given the negative EBITDA and operating cash flow, traditional leverage metrics are not meaningful; instead, the focus should be on liquidity runway. The company's substantial cash and short-term investments exceed debt, but continued cash burn could erode this buffer. The indicative financial risk profile is not a rating, but it signals heightened credit risk until profitability and cash generation recover.

credit_strengths.text: 百度的資產負債表仍是核心信用優勢，其不受限制現金及短期投資超過呈報債務，形成淨現金狀況。此流動性緩衝為當前盈利下滑提供重大緩衝，並支持公司無需外部再融資即可履行短期義務的能力。
相對於流動負債，公司維持龐大的流動資產基礎，流動比率穩居行業中位數之上。這表明即使經營現金流轉為負數，短期流動性及營運資金靈活性依然穩健，讓管理層有時間執行其AI投資策略。

key_risks.text: 如其風險因素所披露，百度核心線上營銷業務面臨具挑戰性宏觀經濟環境及激烈競爭的持續壓力。過去三個財政年度收入下降，經營利潤轉為虧損，反映結構性不利因素可能削弱未來現金產生及償債能力。
根據風險因素，公司對基礎模型及生成式AI的重大投資帶來商業化不確定性及不斷演變的監管風險。這些投資連同資本開支，已導致自由現金流及經營現金流為負，引發對現金回報可持續性及潛在外部融資需求的擔憂。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營利潤不足以覆蓋利息支出，利息覆蓋率為負且遠低於行業中位數。這表明當前盈利不支持償債，公司依賴其現金儲備及潛在資產出售來履行利息義務，此乃重大信用弱點。
自由現金流嚴重為負，相對於債務代表大量現金消耗，而經營現金流亦轉為負數。儘管淨現金狀況提供緩衝，負自由現金流對債務比率凸顯公司未能從營運產生足夠現金償還債務，需要動用資產負債表。

overall_credit_view.text: 百度的信用狀況受收入下降、經營虧損及負自由現金流壓力，受宏觀經濟不利因素及巨額AI投資驅動。淨現金狀況及強勁流動性提供臨時緩衝，但負利息覆蓋率及現金消耗引發對公司在無資產出售或再融資情況下償債能力的擔憂。
鑑於EBITDA及經營現金流為負，傳統槓桿指標不具意義；相反，焦點應在於流動性續航力。公司龐大現金及短期投資超過債務，但持續現金消耗可能侵蝕此緩衝。指示性財務風險狀況並非評級，但預示在盈利能力及現金產生恢復之前信用風險加劇。
